description: Writes the eight business-notes/ files (00-start-here.md, business-facts.md, services-and-prices.md, faqs.md, policies.md, offers.md, decisions.md, voice.md) from what the owner has shared. Blanks become [Fill in: ...] lines so the bot sees the gap instead of guessing. Remove names, phone numbers and emails from samples first.

decisions.description: Decisions the owner has made, one per line.

offers.description: Current offers, each with an end date.

services.description: One service per line, with its price or range.

voice_never.description: Lines for the Never list in voice.md.

voice_samples.description: Real messages the owner wrote, with personal details removed.

voice_tone.description: A few words on how the business sounds.

name: generate_starter_brief_files
title: Generate the business-notes/ starter files
